title: Slave Dynasty Qutubuddin Aibak
definition: Qutubuddin Aibak (1206–1210 AD) was the founder of the Mamluk (Slave) Dynasty and the first independent Muslim ruler of the Delhi Sultanate, establishing the foundation of Turko-Afghan rule in India.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the transition from Rajput polity to Islamic Sultanate, the evolution of Indo-Islamic architecture, and the consolidation of military-feudal structures in medieval India.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Slave Dynasty Qutubuddin Aibak.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
